column1: # Weapon data table v2 for the survivor-like shop.
# Stat values are gameplay-tuning placeholders calibrated against enemies.json
# (round-1 base HP: crawler 10 / swarmling 4 / brute 60 / boss 1800+).
#   id             — unique integer key. 1-99 = shop weapons, 100+ = evolution-only.
#   name           — display name (currently unused by UI
#   spawn_origin   — Front | Around | Mouse           (where the projectile is born)
#   movement       — Straight | Spiral | Fixed | Orbital | Follow
#                    Follow = independent entity that trails the player and acts on
#                    its own cooldown (turret/pet). Reuses summoner-style AI.
#   on_hit         — Vanish | NoChange | Reflect | Multiply | Chain
#                    Chain = jump to nearest un-hit enemy within range
#   damage         — int hp removed per hit. For Sustained / Fixed-field weapons this is
#                    damage PER TICK (see damage_interval), not per shot.
#   cooldown       — seconds between fires (ignored for Sustained, kept as 0)
#   projectile_speed — px / sec (loader divides by kPxPerCell=50 -> world units/sec).
#   lifetime       — seconds before despawn. 0 = persists while Sustained / until replaced.
#   level_up_field — Damage | Cooldown | Count | Speed | Size
#   size           — visual scale (uniform). 0.25 = legacy hard-coded value.
#   acceleration   — speed delta / sec, px/sec (loader divides by kPxPerCell).
#   aim_mode       — Nearest | LowestHP | Forward | Cursor | Radial | Random
#                    Initial heading / target. Forward = player facing/move dir.
#                    Radial = evenly split around player. Cursor = toward mouse.
#   spread_deg     — fan angle (degrees) over which `count` projectiles are distributed.
#                    0 = single line / stacked. Used by count>1 weapons.
#   max_hits       — enemies a projectile may damage before despawning.
#   damage_interval— seconds between damage ticks for Sustained or persistent Fixed
#   knockback      — impulse applied to enemy on hit (world units). + pushes away,
#                    - pulls toward the impact point (gravity/vacuum), 0 = none.
#   evolves_into   — id this weapon becomes when evolved. 0 = no evolution.
#   evolve_min_level — weapon level required before evolution is offered. 0 = none.
#   shop_available — 1 = appears in shop pool, 0 = obtainable only via evolution.
#   trail_style    — none | tracer | plasma | spark | comet

column2: comet = long fading tail. Blank => tracer.
